data_contract.neural: IC_data_trial1/2.mat hold animals × time bins × channels multi-unit spike counts; 1 bin=32 audio samples (762.9395 Hz).
data_contract.labels: sound_data.mat gives calibrated four30-second sounds; channel_CFs, animals and measurement_times identify units, animals and model nonstationarity input. Schema documented by publisher, payload not read.
data_contract.split: This is the published exposed evaluation set, not a new test. Only trial1 calibration versus trial2 evaluation is feasible within current public subset; seven animals were represented in model training.
data_contract.controls: Compare model to trial-to-trial reliability, mean response and linear acoustic baseline; time-shift alignment and within-animal unit-frequency mismatch controls.
data_contract.independence: Aggregate uncertainty over7animals, not thousands of channels as independent subjects.
